format: {name, note, detail: {item, events, revisions}, pins: {"<rev>": "<hash>"}, expect: {ok, problem?, current?: {rev, hash}, acceptedOnPond?}}. `detail` is GET /asks/{id} as the Pond answers a client sending X-Hook-Protocol: 6, ids and timestamps as recorded (the clock was pinned; hashes cover `at`). A tampered case edits that JSON and recomputes exactly the hashes it must, so the client's check (every rev 1..N, each hash, each prev, each body strict, title/urgency/from unchanged, the newest the item's revision, then the pins) fails for `problem` and no earlier reason. problem: badHash:<rev>, badChain:<rev>, unreadable:<rev>, missing, fixedFieldChanged:<rev>, rolledBack. acceptedOnPond is min(max(item.revision.acceptedRev, 1), current rev).
